Great game, great devs, great community.

The 3 year anniversary for it's alpha will be in about a month, and the 1.0 launch was pretty recent- yet there have been and still are consistent updates including major content updates to an already finished and amazing game that has way more than it needs in order to be worthy of the price. 

You can tell there's a lot of love in this game, the devs put it into the game and the game put it into us (giggity). There are so many little things in the game that really could have been omitted but just serve to make your time more enjoyable. I literally can't think of another game in which the LOBBY is this much fun.

Some games end up feeling like work after you grind for a while realizing that you're playing to get stronger to play to get stronger... and then it all just gets stale and feels pointless. This game is actually fun and exciting though- every mission is different and you never know how things will shake out. You have assignments to earn unlocks and chase upgrades, but the missions themselves are intrinsically rewarding and worthwhile- I'm never playing just to reach a goal.

The gun-play is fun and satisfying, with a good variety of weaponry, gadgets, and grenades across all classes (not to mention the upgrades).
The variety of biomes and missions is good enough for me and yet the devs are adding even more. 
The four classes all feel different and important. In regards to design, no class steps on the toes of another.
There are always people to play with, and the difficulty scales well with team size.
The procedural generation has been implemented so well.

The devs really went above and beyond...

I honestly wish I could think up some objective negatives so that I don't seem like a biased fanboy, but really it comes down to the subjective. I guess don't play this game if you have crippling cherophobia, arachnophobia, nyctophobia, or achondroplasiaphobia. You should more or less know what you're getting into if you watch some videos.

Very fun cooperative FPS. The mining aspect is surprisingly enjoyable and the way the different dwarves work together is brilliant. One of my favorite games - I bought multiple copies for family members so we could play together. The one thing I think the game could really use would be a large group mode so that you could play with more than 4 people at a time.

This game is genuinely one of the best co-op games there is. Teamwork is very important in DRG, luckily the 4 classes have a very good synergy and each class has its own unique playstyle. Usually in games with multiple classes I tend to only like one or two of the options but in DRG it's really hard for me to pick a favourite class! It's a lot of fun to play with friends but the singleplayer experience is also very solid! And if you don't like playing alone, you can join a public lobby. This game has a great community full of people who play as a team.
